name: Buitrago del Lozoya (Spain)
description: Divided per saltire, the upper and lower triangles yellow with the words AVE and MARIA in black, the hoist and fly triangles green each with a red band edged yellow, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Buitrago del Lozoya (a holm oak and a black bull on yellow).
history: The arms and flag of Buitrago del Lozoya were approved on 13 February 2002, published in the Boletín Oficial del Estado on 19 March 2002; the flag is of proportions 2:3, quartered per saltire, the first and fourth green with a red band edged yellow.

features.role: hoist triangle with a red band edged yellow
fly triangle with a red band edged yellow
